item.title: Lawmaker Kim Seung-won on Lee's "Haven't Read the Criminal Procedure Act" Remark: "He Knows Full Well What's in It" (與 김승원, 李 ‘형소법 안읽어봐서’ 발언에 “내용 다 알고계실 것”)
item.description:
Regarding the Criminal Procedure Act, which includes the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers and was pushed through by the Democratic Party of Korea, Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Seung-won said on the 7th, "(President Lee Jae-myung) probably knows full well what the new Criminal Procedure Act contains." <<> This is a response to President Lee Jae-myung's question at a recent Cabinet meeting, "I haven't read the amended Criminal Procedure Act, but does it say under the amended act that prosecutors must not investigate?" <<> On this day, Lawmaker Kim appeared on YTN Radio and, when asked, "Isn't it because the bill processed by the Democratic Party didn't quite sit well with the president?", said, "We held informal meetings with numerous people. We also consulted with the Prime Minister's Office, the Ministry of Justice, and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, so it wasn't a unilateral bill." <<> Regarding Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho and others saying, "There should be exceptional supplementary investigative powers," Kim said, "It's fine for prosecutors to conduct supplementary investigations directly, but as I mentioned earlier, after granting those powers, there are actually dozens of cases like 'Go change the typo and bring it back' and other such directives." <<> Regarding the investigation of powerful figures, including politicians—particularly the probe into lawmaker Kim Byung-ki, who left the Democratic Party, which has been delayed for nearly a year—Kim said, "I've heard that the investigation will soon be wrapped up and the results announced." <<> He added, "We established the Senior Officials Corruption Investigation Office, a kind of Korean FBI, where veteran police officers, prosecutors, and prosecution investigators work together to keep each other in check," and "Shouldn't rewards for the public or promotions be handled much better than they are now?" (더불어민주당 주도로 강행 처리한 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 내용을 담은 형사소송법에 대해 민주당 김승원 의원이 “(이재명 대통령은) 새로운 형사소송법 내용이 어떤 건지 아마 다 알고 계실 것”이라고 7일 말했다.)

item.title: U.S. House Protests Network Act — "Major Threat to Press and Free Expression" (美하원, 정통망법 공개 항의… “언론·표현의 자유 중대한 위협”)
item.description:
U.S. House Protests Network Act — "Major Threat to Press and Free Expression" (美하원, 정통망법 공개 항의… “언론·표현의 자유 중대한 위협”)

Republican lawmakers on the U.S. House Judiciary Committee have sent a letter to Kim Jong-cheol, chairman of the Korea Media and Communications Commission (KMCC), expressing concerns over the revised Information and Communications Network Act, known as the "July 7 Law," which took effect last month. In the letter made public on the 6th, the committee stated that the amendment "poses a major threat to press freedom and freedom of expression online, and could be used to censor the online speech of Americans." They said the amendment "targets U.S. companies" and demanded that the KMCC provide an official briefing on its enforcement plans by the 20th of this month. Earlier, the U.S. State Department had also voiced concerns that the law could undermine U.S.–Korea cooperation. This issue, along with the "discrimination against U.S. companies" controversy sparked by the Coupang affair, is increasingly likely to become another obstacle in the bilateral relationship between the two countries. <<> The amendment, passed by the National Assembly last year under the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, is designed to impose punitive liability for "false and manipulated information" and "discriminatory hate speech" in cyberspace. However, concerns have been raised at home and abroad that its arbitrary and vague provisions could be abused by political power to muzzle citizens and the press. Last month, the State Department told this newspaper that it has "significant concerns that the Network Act amendment could lead to excessive content regulation and undermine freedom of expression," adding that "Korea should not impose excessive burdens on U.S. companies, nor should it use the law's implementation as a mechanism to demand censorship of free expression." Deputy Secretary of State for Public Diplomacy Sarah Rogers raised the issue directly with her counterpart at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs during her visit to Seoul in April. <<> Then, on the 6th, Republican House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan, Subcommittee on Administrative and Regulatory Reform and Antitrust Chairman Scott Fitzgerald, and Representatives Darrell Issa and Michael Baumgartner singled out the KMCC to express their concerns regarding the law's implementation. They characterized the amendment as a "major threat to press and free expression," stating that "it raises concerns that the KMCC could punish U.S. companies and their users for exercising rights guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution, and that it could be used to censor the online speech of Americans." They also noted that the law fails to define what constitutes "false information" and lacks specificity regarding the standards and methods of enforcement, adding that "it could be exploited as a tool to censor politically disfavored opinions and could have a chilling effect on free expression and online discourse." <<> The amendment stipulates that large platform operators must remove problematic content, prepare transparency reports, and cooperate with government investigations. The KMCC previously identified Google, Meta, X (formerly Twitter), and TikTok as "large-scale information and communications service providers" subject to regulation. The prevailing view across the U.S. political spectrum is that the law places excessive burdens on American tech companies, with some pointing out that "Korea is following in the footsteps of the European Union, which has sought to control online platforms' operations through the Digital Services Act (DSA) and infringe on the free expression of American citizens." In a separate statement, Fitzgerald said, "No foreign government should have the authority to pressure U.S. companies to censor constitutionally protected speech. Korea's so-called 'false information' law is vague, overbroad, and ripe for abuse. Congress will continue to scrutinize attempts by foreign governments to export censorship and undermine the rights enshrined in the First Amendment." (미 하원 법사위원회 소속 공화당 의원들이 김종철 방송미디어통신위원회(KMCC) 위원장 앞으로 서한을 보내 지난달 7일 시행된 정보통신망법 개정안, 이른바 ‘7·7법’에 대한 우려를 표명한 것으로 나타났다. 법사위는 6일 공개한 서한에서 “개정안은 온라인상의 언론·표현의 자유에 중대한 위협(major threat)이 되며 미국인의 온라인 표현을 검열하는 데 사용될 가능성이 있다”고 했다. “개정안이 미국 기업을 겨냥한 것”이라고 했는데, 이달 20일까지 방미통위가 법 집행 계획에 대한 공식 브리핑을 할 것을 요구했다. 앞서 국무부도 법안이 한미 협력을 저해할 것이란 우려를 표시했는데, 이 문제가 쿠팡 사태로 불거진 ‘미 기업 차별’ 이슈와 더불어 한미 양자(兩者) 관계의 또 다른 장애물로 작용할 가능성이 커졌다.)

item.title: U.S. Pushes Shift in Nuclear Umbrella Strategy... Expanding Share of Short-Range Tactical Nukes (美, 핵우산 전략 전환 추진… 단거리 전술핵 비중 확대)
item.description:
U.S. Pushes Shift in Nuclear Umbrella Strategy... Expanding Share of Short-Range Tactical Nukes (美, 핵우산 전략 전환 추진… 단거리 전술핵 비중 확대)

The U.S. Department of Defense is discussing a new nuclear strategy that expands the role of "tactical nuclear weapons" to prepare for potential Chinese and Russian attacks on allies, NBC News reported on the 5th (local time). The aim is to bolster allied confidence in extended deterrence (the nuclear umbrella) by reshaping the nuclear strategy to place greater emphasis on short-range tactical nuclear weapons targeting limited objectives, rather than long-range "strategic nuclear weapons" that are less likely to be actually used. In other words, it seeks to make nuclear weapons a viable option for actual operations. If this strategy is adopted, it is expected to have significant implications for the defense posture on the Korean Peninsula against North Korean nuclear and missile threats, as well as the security landscape of South Korea and Japan. There is also the possibility of redeploying U.S. tactical nuclear weapons to South Korea, which were fully withdrawn in 1991. (미 국방부가 동맹에 대한 중국·러시아의 공격 가능성에 대비해 ‘전술핵무기’의 역할을 확대하는 새로운 핵전략을 논의하고 있다고 NBC방송이 5일(현지시각) 보도했다. 확장억제(핵우산)에 대한 동맹국 신뢰도를 제고하기 위해, 실제 사용할 가능성이 낮은 장거리 ‘전략핵무기’ 대신 제한된 표적을 겨냥하는 단거리 전술핵에 더 큰 비중을 두는 방향으로 핵전략을 다시 짜려 한다는 것이다. 핵무기를 실제 작전에 쓸 수 있는 선택지로 만들겠다는 얘기다. 이 전략이 채택될 경우 북한 핵·미사일에 대비한 한반도 방위 태세, 한국과 일본의 안보 지형 등에 중대한 영향이 있을 것으로 보인다. 1991년 전면 철수한 주한 미군 전술핵이 재배치될 가능성도 있다.)

A senior U.S. Defense Department official said, "Our view is that we need credible nuclear options," adding that the new strategy, which places more weight on short-range tactical nuclear weapons rather than long-range strategic missiles, would broaden practical and credible choices and contribute to strengthening deterrence. This move is being led by Elbridge Colby, Under Secretary of Defense for Policy, who delivered a closed-door speech on the same day at an extended deterrence symposium held at U.S. Strategic Command (STRATCOM) in Omaha, Nebraska. STRATCOM is a key functional combatant command that oversees global nuclear operations and strategic deterrence. It also holds the mission of providing extended deterrence capabilities to allies, including South Korea. (미 국방부 고위 당국자는 “신뢰할 수 있는 핵 옵션이 필요하다는 게 우리의 견해”라며 장거리 전략 미사일이 아닌 단거리 전술 핵무기에 더 무게를 싣는 새 전략이 실질적이고 신뢰할 수 있는 선택의 폭을 넓혀 억지력 강화에 기여할 것이라고 했다. 이런 움직임은 엘브리지 콜비 국방부 정책 담당 차관이 주도하고 있는데, 콜비는 이날 네브래스카주(州) 오마하의 전략사령부(STRATCOM)에서 열린 확장 억제 심포지엄에 참석해 비공개로 연설을 했다. 전략사는 전 세계 핵전력 운용, 전략적 억제 등을 총괄하는 핵심 기능전투사령부다. 한국을 비롯한 동맹에 확장 억제 능력을 제공하는 임무도 맡고 있다.)

◇Preparing for Chinese-Russian Attacks on U.S. Allies... "Need Usable Tactical Nukes" (◇中·러의 美동맹 공격 대비… “사용 가능한 전술핵 필요”)

U.S. nuclear doctrine is centered on long-range strategic weapons. The core triad consists of Intercontinental Ballistic Missiles (ICBMs) operated from land-based silos, strategic nuclear submarines (SSBNs) that move covertly beneath the seas, and strategic bombers such as B-2s and B-52s that launch nuclear weapons from the air. These three pillars are designed to compensate for each other's vulnerabilities so that not all are destroyed in an enemy first strike, ensuring at least one leg survives to deliver a assured retaliatory nuclear attack. This has been the foundation of the balance of terror—so-called mutually assured destruction (MAD)—which holds that an all-out war between nuclear-armed great powers is impossible. Mutually assured destruction is a "demonstration of capability" that even if one side launches a nuclear strike first, the other can retaliate, leading to the total destruction and annihilation of both sides. It has been credited with serving as the last bastion of peace during the Cold War era. (미국의 핵 교리는 장거리 전략무기를 중심으로 설계되어 있다. 지상 발사 기지에서 운용되는 대륙간탄도미사일(ICBM), 바닷속에서 은밀하게 이동하는 전략핵잠수함(SSBN), 공중에서 핵을 발사하는 B-2·B-52 같은 전략폭격기 등 3대 전력이 핵심이다. 3개의 축이 적의 선제공격에도 모두 파괴되지 않도록 서로의 취약점을 보완하고, 최소 하나의 전력은 생존해 확실한 보복 핵 공격을 할 수 있도록 설계돼 있다. 이는 핵을 가진 강대국 간 전면전은 불가능하다는 공포의 균형, 이른바 ‘상호확증파괴(MAD)’가 작동하는 근간이 됐다. 상호확증파괴는 한쪽이 먼저 핵 공격을 해도 다른 쪽이 반격해 양쪽 다 완전히 파괴·절멸시킬 수 있다는 ‘능력 증명’이다. 냉전 시대 평화의 최후 보루 역할을 해왔다는 평가를 받는다.)

In contrast, tactical nuclear weapons are designed to strike limited targets such as enemy frontline units or bases to achieve victory on the battlefield. Colby has long supported tactical nukes equipped with small, short-range warheads that target specific small-scale objectives on the battlefield rather than entire cities. This is because he views the current U.S. nuclear doctrine, which relies on long-range strategic weapons, as lacking credibility. A senior Defense Department official said, "If you want extended deterrence to be credible, you have to provide the political leadership of that country with nuclear forces that are plausible enough to actually use—something that makes common sense" adding, "Otherwise, our leadership's options shrink to extreme choices that adversaries won't believe in, failing to function as deterrence." (그에 반해 전술핵은 적군의 직결부대나 기지 등 제한된 표적을 공격해 전장에서의 승리를 목표로 하는 무기다. 콜비는 전체 도시보다 전장의 특정한 소규모 표적을 겨냥하는 소형 단거리 탄두를 장착한 전술핵을 오랫동안 지지해 왔다. 장거리 전략무기에 의존하는 미국의 현재 핵 교리가 신뢰성이 떨어진다고 보기 때문이다. 국방부 고위 당국자는 “확장억제가 신뢰받기를 원한다면 실제로 사용할 수 있는 상식적인 생각이 들 정도의 핵전력을 해당 국가의 정치 지도부에 제공해야 한다”며 “그렇지 않으면 우리 지도부의 선택지가 적국이 믿지 않는 극단적 선택으로 축소돼 억지력으로서 제구실을 하지 못할 것”이라고 했다.)

China is rapidly increasing its nuclear warhead stockpile, modernizing its delivery systems, and expanding its nuclear forces to unprecedented levels. It is currently believed to possess more than 600 warheads, with projections of securing over 1,000 by 2030. Additionally, the New START (Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty) with Russia expired in February of this year, collapsing the U.S.-Russia nuclear arms control framework. (중국은 핵탄두 수량을 빠르게 늘리고 투발 수단을 현대화하며 핵전력을 전례 없는 수준으로 확장하고 있는데, 현재 600기 이상을 보유한 것으로 알려졌고 2030년까지 1000기 이상을 확보할 것으로 전망된다. 러시아와도 핵 군축 조약인 뉴스타트(New START·신전략무기감축협정)가 올해 2월 만료돼 미·러 간 핵무기 통제 체제가 무너진 상태다.)

Although still in the discussion phase, if such a plan is actually adopted, it is expected to have considerable impact on the defense posture against North Korea's nuclear threats on the Korean Peninsula. U.S. Forces Korea operated various types of tactical nuclear weapons from 1958, with up to 700 deployed at their peak. In 1991, under the "Joint Declaration on the Denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula," the roughly 100-plus remaining tactical nukes were fully withdrawn. Amid mounting North Korean nuclear threats, whenever calls for nuclear armament or tactical nuclear deployment have arisen domestically and internationally, the U.S. side has maintained the position that strategic nuclear weapons operated from the homeland and the Pacific already provide sufficient extended deterrence. In 2023, the U.S. and South Korea launched the Nuclear Consultative Group (NCG) to strengthen planning and consultation on nuclear deterrence policies, but doubts—exemplified by the question, "Would the U.S. sacrifice Los Angeles (LA) for Seoul?"—still linger. In the case of NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization), nuclear sharing is in place with U.S. tactical nuclear weapons deployed to European allies. The U.S. handles operational planning and decision-making, while NATO allies provide facilities for nuclear deployment and take on part of the nuclear delivery missions. (아직 논의 단계지만 이런 구상이 실제로 채택될 경우 한반도에서의 북핵 대비 태세에도 적지 않은 영향이 있을 것으로 전망된다. 주한미군은 1958년부터 다양한 형태의 전술 핵무기를 운용했고, 가장 많을 때는 700기가 배치돼 있었다. 1991년 ‘한반도 비핵화 공동선언’에 따라 100여 개 남짓 남아 있던 전술핵을 전면 철수했다. 점증하는 북핵 위협 속 국내외에서 핵무장, 전술핵 배치 요구가 나올 때마다 미측은 본토와 태평양에서 운용하는 전략핵으로도 확장억제를 충분히 제공할 수 있다는 입장을 유지해왔다. 2023년 한미가 핵 억제 정책의 기획·협의를 강화하기 위해 핵협의그룹(NCG)을 출범시켰지만, ‘미국이 서울을 위해 로스앤젤레스(LA)를 희생할 수 있을 것인가’라는 질문으로 대표되는 의구심이 여전히 걷히지 않은 상황이다. 나토(NATO·북대서양조약기구)의 경우 미 전술핵을 유럽 동맹에 배치하는 핵 공유가 이뤄지고 있다. 미국은 작전기획과 의사결정을, 나토 동맹국은 핵무기 배치 시설을 제공하고 핵무기 투발 임무의 일부를 담당한다.)

However, placing greater emphasis on tactical nukes raises concerns that the threshold for nuclear use could be lowered, increasing the risk of conventional wars escalating into nuclear wars. There are also criticisms that in scenarios requiring the deployment of long-range nuclear weapons, the president might make different choices, thereby weakening the deterrent posture. While nuclear use principles and adjustments to the nuclear posture are the prerogative of the executive branch, translating them into actual forces and budgets requires congressional cooperation. Colby drew significant discontent even within the Republican Party last year for failing to properly consult Congress while drafting the new National Defense Strategy (NDS). A senior congressional figure told NBC that it was "a weak and timid study, far removed from the president's stated position of making nuclear deterrence great again." President Donald Trump last year urged the resumption of nuclear weapons testing, suspended since 1992, to counter the pace of Chinese and Russian weapons development. (다만 전술핵을 더 강조하게 될 경우 핵무기 사용 문턱이 낮아져 재래식 전쟁이 핵전쟁으로 번질 위험이 더 커질 수 있다는 우려가 나온다. 장거리 핵무기를 배치해야 하는 시나리오에서 대통령이 다른 선택을 하게 해 대비 태세가 약화할 수 있다는 지적도 있다. 핵 사용 원칙이나 핵 태세 조정은 정부의 고유 권한이지만, 이를 실제 전력·예산에 반영하려면 의회의 협조가 중요하다. 콜비는 지난해 새 국방 전략(NDS)을 작성하면서 의회와 제대로 상의하지 않아 공화당 내에서도 불만이 적지 않은 상황이다. 의회 고위 인사는 NBC에 “핵 억제력을 다시 위대하게 만들겠다는 대통령의 공표된 입장과는 아주 많이 동떨어진, 나약하고 소심한 연구”라고 비판했다. 도널드 트럼프 대통령은 지난해 중·러의 무기 개발 속도에 대응하기 위해 1992년 이후 중단한 핵무기 실험의 재개를 촉구한 바 있다.)

☞Strategic Nukes vs. Tactical Nukes (☞전략핵·전술핵)

Strategic nuclear weapons are designed to destroy broad areas such as enemy territory or national infrastructure, with yields ranging from hundreds of kilotons (kt) to megatons (Mt). In contrast, tactical nuclear weapons are used to attack military targets in limited areas, such as enemy units or bases, and typically have yields of tens of kilotons or less. While strategic nukes are "war-deterrence" weapons based on the principle of mutually assured destruction (MAD)—"if I die, you die too"—tactical nukes are closer to weapons intended for actual combat use. (전략핵무기는 수백 킬로톤(㏏)에서 메가톤(Mt)급 위력으로 적의 영토나 국가기반 등 광범위한 지역을 파괴할 목적의 무기다. 반면 전술핵무기는 적 부대나 기지 등 제한된 지역의 군사적 목표를 공격하는 핵무기로 통상 수십킬로톤 이하 위력을 갖는다. 전략핵이 ‘내가 죽으면 너도 죽는다’는 상호확증파괴(MAD) 원리에 기반한 ‘전쟁 억제용’이라면, 전술핵은 실전용 무기에 가깝다.)

item.title: Ruling party Seoul lawmakers in emergency over 'real estate tax headwinds' — "Government proposal must be revised" (‘부동산세 역풍’ 비상 걸린 與 서울 의원들 “정부안 수정해야”)
item.description:
Ruling party Seoul lawmakers in emergency over 'real estate tax headwinds' — "Government proposal must be revised" (‘부동산세 역풍’ 비상 걸린 與 서울 의원들 “정부안 수정해야”)

Democratic Party of Korea lawmakers from Seoul districts held a real estate measures meeting on the 6th, raising the need to revise the strengthened taxation on non-resident single-homeowners, with concerns growing even within the ruling party over the government's real estate tax reform plan. The party leadership has been defending the reform plan day after day, calling it "tax normalization for growth and people's livelihoods." However, on this day, a significant number of ruling party lawmakers with districts in Seoul reportedly argued that the government proposal should be revised, saying "public sentiment in Seoul could be shaken entirely." (더불어민주당 서울 지역 의원들이 6일 부동산 대책 회의를 열고 비(非)거주 1주택자 과세 강화에 대한 수정 필요성을 제기하는 등, 여당 내에서도 정부의 부동산 세제 개편안에 대한 우려가 커지고 있다. 당 지도부는 이번 개편안을 두고 “성장과 민생을 위한 조세 정상화”라며 연일 엄호하고 있다. 하지만 이날 서울에 지역구를 둔 여당 의원 상당수는 “서울 민심이 통째로 흔들릴 수 있다”며 정부안을 수정해야 한다고 주장한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The Democratic Party's Seoul City Chapter held a closed-door briefing that morning at the National Assembly Members' Office Building under the theme "Understanding changes in real estate tax policy and their impact on Seoul residents' sentiment," attended by 9 lawmakers from Seoul districts and 27 Seoul city council members. At the meeting, lawmakers reportedly expressed concerns that public sentiment in Seoul is rapidly deteriorating, particularly in the Han River belt areas such as Mapo, Yongsan, and Seongdong, over the issue of taxing non-resident single-homeowners, and offered opinions that tax rates and other factors should be adjusted to account for various situations. (민주당 서울시당은 이날 오전 국회 의원회관에서 서울 지역구 국회의원 9명과 서울시의원 27명이 참석한 가운데 ‘부동산 세제 정책 변화의 이해와 서울 지역 민심에 미치는 영향’이라는 주제로 간담회를 열었다. 비공개로 진행된 이날 회의에서 의원들은 비거주 1주택자 과세 문제로 마용성(마포·용산·성동) 등 한강 벨트를 중심으로 서울 민심이 급속도로 악화하고 있다는 우려와 함께 다양한 상황을 고려해 과세 비율 등을 조정할 필요가 있다는 의견을 내놓은 것으로 전해졌다.)

According to the real estate tax reform plan announced by the government on the 3rd, for resident single-homeowners, the basic exemption amount was raised from the current publicly announced land price of 1.2 billion won (approximately 2.03 billion won in market value) to 1.4 billion won, easing the burden of the comprehensive real estate tax. However, for non-resident single-homeowners, the basic exemption is lowered from 1.2 billion won to 900 million won, resulting in a heavier tax burden. (지난 3일 정부가 발표한 부동산 세제 개편안에 따르면, 거주 1주택자에 대해선 현행 공시지가 12억원에서 14억원(시세 약 20억3000만원)으로 기본공제 금액을 올려 종부세 부담을 완화했다. 그러나 비거주 1주택자는 기본공제가 12억원에서 9억원으로 낮아져 세 부담이 커지게 된다.)

In response, a lawmaker whose district is in the Han River belt reportedly argued, "Imposing taxes uniformly even on apartments worth around 2 billion won in Seoul is 'tax reverse discrimination'" and "the comprehensive real estate tax exemption threshold for non-resident single-homeowners (900 million won) should be raised." That lawmaker said in a phone conversation with this newspaper, "Even for apartments of the same price, the neighbor who actually lives there receives relief from the comprehensive real estate tax and capital gains tax deduction benefits, while a single-homeowner who had to vacate their home for unavoidable reasons such as a provincial assignment or overseas work is excluded from those benefits" and "It makes no sense for the tax burden of middle-class single-homeowners to differ by several times depending solely on whether they actually reside in the property." (이에 대해 한강 벨트가 지역구인 한 의원은 “서울의 20억원대 아파트들까지 일률적으로 과세하는 건 ‘세금 역차별’”이라며 “비거주 1주택자(9억원)의 종부세 공제 기준을 상향해야 한다”고 주장한 것으로 전해졌다. 해당 의원은 본지 통화에서 “같은 가격의 아파트여도 실거주하는 옆집은 종부세 부담 완화와 양도세 공제 혜택을 받는 반면, 지방 발령이나 해외 근무 등 불가피한 사유로 집을 비운 1주택자는 혜택에서 제외된다”며 “중산층 1주택자의 세 부담이 실거주 여부만으로 몇 배 차이가 나는 상황은 말이 안 된다”고 했다.)

Another Seoul-area lawmaker reportedly said, "We need to investigate in detail the cases of 'non-residence for genuine demand purposes' — people who want to live in their homes but cannot — and provide them with the same benefits as residents or recognize tax exemptions." (서울 지역의 다른 의원은 “실거주를 하고 싶어도 하지 못하는 ‘실수요 목적의 비거주’ 사례를 구체적으로 조사해 거주자와 동일한 혜택을 주거나 과세 예외를 인정해야 한다”고 말한 것으로 전해졌다.)

There were also opinions that the long-term holding special deduction for capital gains tax should not be eliminated all at once but phased out gradually to ease the shock, or that taxation should be eased for those who have held properties since before the system was introduced. A Democratic Party official said, "Lawmakers who did not attend the briefing, wary of appearing to openly oppose the government plan, also have many concerns." However, it was noted that some opinions were also offered that "since the tax burden is being strengthened only on ultra-high-priced homes, there will be no major side effects." (양도세 장기보유특별공제 혜택을 한 번에 없애지 말고 단계적으로 줄여 충격을 완화하거나, 제도 시행 이전 주택을 보유해 온 사람들에 대해선 과세를 완화해야 한다는 의견도 나왔다고 한다. 민주당 관계자는 “정부안에 공개 반대하는 모양새가 되는 것을 경계해 간담회에 참석하지 않은 의원들도 우려가 많다”고 했다. 다만 “초고가 주택에 한해 세 부담을 강화하는 것인 만큼 큰 부작용이 없을 것”이란 의견도 나왔다고 한다.)

After failing to reclaim the Seoul mayoralty in the June 3 local elections, concerns have been growing among Seoul-area lawmakers that "if the government plan goes through as is, it may be difficult to survive the 2028 general election." In a survey conducted by Hangil Research and Kuki News from the 1st to the 3rd of 1,000 adults aged 18 and older nationwide evaluating the current government's real estate policies, 57.6% said it was doing poorly. Approval was 35.6%, 22.0 percentage points lower than negative evaluations. Notably, negative evaluations were highest among those in their 30s at 70.4%. (6·3 지방선거에서 서울시장 탈환에 실패한 이후 서울 지역 의원들 사이에선 “정부안대로라면 2028년 총선에서 살아남기 어려울 수 있다”는 우려가 나오고 있다. 한길리서치·쿠키뉴스가 1~3일 전국 만 18세 이상 남녀 1000명을 대상으로 현 정부 부동산 정책에 대한 평가를 조사한 결과, 잘못하고 있다는 응답은 57.6%였다. 잘하고 있다는 평가는 35.6%로, 부정 평가보다 22.0%포인트 낮았다. 특히 30대의 부정 평가가 70.4%로 가장 높았다.)

Open opposition to the reform plan is also continuing within the party. Lawmaker Hwang Hee (Seoul Yangcheon A) wrote on Facebook the previous day, "Regardless of residence status, all single-homeowners should be protected from taxation" and "Owning one home is a fundamental housing right." Lawmaker Kim Young-ho (Seoul Seodaemun B) said, "Even if tax reform goes through, the ruling party should take the lead in persuading the government to produce a plan that the public can accept." Lawmaker Lee Yeon-hee (Cheongju Heungdeok, North Chungcheong) also said in a broadcast interview that day, "I doubt whether the government carefully reflected the diverse circumstances of non-resident single-homeowners when preparing the plan." (당내에선 개편안에 대한 공개 반발도 이어지고 있다. 황희(서울 양천갑) 의원은 전날 페이스북 글에서 “거주·비거주 구분 없이 1주택자는 (과세로부터) 모두 보호하는 것이 맞다”며 “1주택 소유는 주거기본권”이라고 했다. 김영호(서울 서대문을) 의원은 “정부를 설득해 세제개편이 되더라도 국민이 수용할 수 있는 안을 여당이 주도해서 만들어야 한다”고 했다. 이연희(충북 청주흥덕) 의원도 이날 방송 인터뷰에서 “정부가 안을 마련할 때 1주택 비거주자의 다양한 사정을 꼼꼼히 반영했는지 의문”이라고 했다.)

As concerns grow, a mood that "the government plan can be revised" is being detected within the party. Lawmaker Kim Young-bae (Seoul Seongbuk A), a candidate for chair of the Democratic Party's Seoul City Chapter, said in a phone conversation with this newspaper, "After further discussion among Seoul-area lawmakers, we may decide on measures such as preparing a party-level adjustment proposal or recommending revisions to the government plan." Policy Committee Chairman Han Jeong-ae said at a policy coordination meeting that day, "The government and ruling party are well aware of the public's concerns about housing supply and the jeonse/monthly rent market" and "The party and government will consult even on detailed matters." (갈수록 우려가 커지자 당내에선 “정부안을 수정할 수 있다”는 분위기가 감지된다. 민주당 서울시당위원장 후보인 김영배(서울 성북갑) 의원은 본지 통화에서 “(서울 지역 의원들 간) 논의를 더 거친 뒤 당 차원의 조정안 마련이나 정부안 수정 건의 등을 결정할 수 있을 것”이라고 했다. 한정애 정책위의장은 이날 정책조정회의에서 “정부·여당은 주택 공급, 전월세 시장 등에 대한 국민 우려를 잘 안다”며 “세부적인 부분까지 당정이 협의하겠다”고 했다.)

Seoul-area lawmakers also announced they would establish a special headquarters at the Seoul City Chapter level to regularly monitor and respond to housing supply issues in Seoul. Lawmaker Kim Nam-geun (Seoul Seongbuk B) said, "During Mayor Oh Se-hoon's four years in office, housing supply fell by about 60% compared to the 10-year average" and "Because Seoul's need for diverse housing supply has been neglected, housing supply has not gone well." (서울 지역 의원들은 서울시당 차원의 특별본부를 신설해 서울 내 주택 공급 문제도 수시로 점검·대응하겠다고 밝혔다. 김남근(서울 성북을) 의원은 “오세훈 시장 시정 4년 동안 10년 평균에 비해 주택 공급이 60%가량 줄었다”며 “다양한 주택 공급이 필요한 서울시의 상황을 외면하다 보니 주택 공급이 잘 안 됐다”고 했다.)

item.title: Public Criticism of Lee Government's 'Leverage·Real Estate' Policies... Ruling Party Convention Shooting Itself in the Foot (‘레버리지·부동산’ 李정부 정책 공개비판… 제 발등 찍는 與전대)
item.description:
Public Criticism of Lee Government's 'Leverage·Real Estate' Policies... Ruling Party Convention Shooting Itself in the Foot (‘레버리지·부동산’ 李정부 정책 공개비판… 제 발등 찍는 與전대)

As the competition for party leadership within the Democratic Party of Korea intensifies, party leader candidates who claim to be "pro-Lee" have begun publicly criticizing the policies of the Lee Jae-myung administration while engaging in a contest of ideological clarity. Within the party, concerns have emerged that the party could follow in the footsteps of the defunct Uri Party, which spiraled into internal division, with some asking, "How do they plan to stitch up the conflict after the convention is over?" (더불어민주당 당권 경쟁이 격화하는 가운데 ‘친명’을 자처하는 당대표 후보들이 선명성 경쟁을 벌이면서 이재명 정부 정책을 공개 비판하기 시작했다. 당내에서는 “전당대회가 끝나고 갈등을 어떻게 봉합하려고 이러느냐”며 당내 분열로 치달았던 열린우리당의 전철을 밟게 될 수 있다는 우려까지 나왔다.)

At a TV debate on the 5th, party leader candidates attacked each other as "anti-Lee runners" and "traitors," and on the 6th, they continued attacking their rivals all day long. Candidate Kim Min-seok appeared on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel that morning and said, "If there had been no 'Myeong-cheong (Lee Jae-myung·Jung Cheong-rae) confrontation' and conflict, why would I have resigned as prime minister to run (in the party leadership race)?" adding that there are "more than 10" grounds for calling Jung a anti-Lee figure. He again raised the "three-way secret alliance of anti-Lee, divisionists, and Shincheonji," continuing to allege that Jung receives support from Shincheonji. In an afternoon lecture to party members in Gwangju, South Jeolla, Kim said that if he becomes party leader, he will spend four months reviewing problems with candidate nominations in local elections under Jung Cheong-rae's leadership. (지난 5일 TV 토론회에서 상대방을 ‘반명 주자’ ‘배신자’라고 몰아붙인 당대표 후보들은 6일에도 온종일 상대 후보를 공격했다. 김민석 후보는 이날 아침 김어준씨 유튜브에 출연해 “명청(이재명·정청래) 대전과 갈등이 없었으면 뭐 하러 총리를 그만두고 (당대표 선거에) 나왔겠느냐”며 정 후보가 반명인 근거가 “10개가 넘는다”고 했다. “반명·분열주의·신천지 3자 비밀 연합”을 다시 거론하면서 정 후보가 신천지의 지원을 받는다는 의혹 제기도 이어갔다. 김 후보는 이날 오후 전남광주에서 당원들을 대상으로 한 강연에서는 당대표가 되면 정청래 지도부 당시 지방선거 공천의 문제점을 4개월간 점검하겠다고 했다.)

In response to Kim's allegations of Shincheonji's involvement in the convention, Candidate Jung Cheong-rae wrote on Facebook, "If you can't provide evidence, it's a false report," adding, "Those who file false reports are as bad as arsonists—don't vote for bad people." He then went on to say, "Shouldn't Candidate Kim Min-seok, as a former prime minister, apologize to the people who are shedding tears of blood over single-stock leveraged ETFs?" directly attacking the Lee administration's launch of single-stock ETFs. At the previous day's debate, Jung had also said, "If (the government) had consulted the party before (launching single-stock ETFs), I would have advised caution." (정청래 후보는 김 후보의 신천지 전당대회 개입 의혹 제기에 대해 페이스북에 “근거를 못 대면 허위 신고가 된다”며 “허위 신고자는 방화범 못지않은 나쁜 사람이고, 나쁜 사람 뽑지 말자”고 했다. 그러더니 “단일 종목 레버리지 ETF로 피눈물 흘리는 국민께 김민석 후보는 전직 총리로서 사과해야 하지 않을까”라며 이재명 정부가 한 단일 종목 ETF 출시를 직격했다. 정 후보는 전날 토론회에서도 “(정부가 단일 종목 ETF 출시 전에) 당에 협의해 왔더라면 저는 신중하게 하자고 했을 것”이라고 했다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil also pointed out the government's policy failure at the previous day's debate, saying "(The single-stock ETF launch) should have been handled with caution." Regarding the government's real estate tax reform plan, he said, "If taxes take away all of (the capital gains), you can't buy a new home of the same grade," and "There's a need to minimize the reduction of the long-term holding special deduction." At the same time, targeting Jung, who had raised the issue of Kim's responsibility, he said, "When problems arise, rather than shifting blame to the prime minister or president, the party should take full responsibility—that's the attitude expected of the ruling party leader." (송영길 후보도 전날 토론회에서 “(단일 종목 ETF 출시는) 신중했어야 한다”며 정부의 정책 실패를 지적했다. 정부의 부동산 세제 개편안에 대해 “세금으로 (양도소득을) 다 떼어가 버리면 새로운 집을, 같은 급으로는 살 수가 없다”며 “장기보유특별공제 축소를 최소화할 필요가 있다”고 했다. 그러면서도 김 후보 책임론을 꺼낸 정 후보를 겨냥해 “문제가 생기면 책임을 총리나 대통령에게 돌릴 것이 아니라 당이 다 책임지는 것이 집권 여당 대표의 자세”라고 했다.)

Kim's camp denied the responsibility argument that day, stating, "The spread of the false claim that 'the introduction of leveraged ETFs was directed by Prime Minister Kim Min-seok' has been confirmed. It is clearly fake news, and we will take immediate legal action." On the controversy over real estate policy failures, Kim shifted responsibility to relevant ministries, saying, "Although the government is pursuing supply-guarantee policies, there are areas where progress is slow due to disagreements among ministries on the ground." (김 후보 캠프는 이날 “‘레버리지 ETF 도입은 김민석 총리 지시’라는 허위 사실 유포가 확인됐다. 명백한 가짜 뉴스로서 즉시 법적 조치할 예정”이라며 책임론을 부인했다. 김 후보는 부동산 정책 실패 논란에는 “정부가 공급 보장 정책을 쓰고 있음에도 현장에서 부처 간 이견 등으로 진전이 잘 안 되는 부분이 있다”며 책임을 관계 부처로 돌렸다.)

The party's election commission expressed concern to each camp, saying, "Serious overheating is occurring during the primary process." The commission stated, "Cases of violating election rules, such as disturbances inside and outside joint speech venues and risks of clashes between supporters, are occurring repeatedly," and "We will hold clear offenders strictly accountable." (민주당 선관위는 “경선 과정에서 심각한 과열 양상이 빚어지고 있다”며 각 캠프에 우려를 표시했다. 선관위는 “합동 연설회장 안팎에서 소란, 지지자 간 충돌 위험 등 선거 수칙을 위반하는 사례가 연이어 발생하고 있다”며 “명백한 해당 행위에 엄중한 책임을 물을 것”이라고 했다.)

Senior lawmakers have also voiced concerns about the life-or-death competition for party leadership. Rep. Park Ji-won, who earlier said, "If the convention goes like this, (the party) will break or collapse," appeared on MBC that day and said, "If you're candidates for party leader, you should be talking about the people's livelihoods—should you be fighting with everything exploding?" adding, "The level of rhetoric is getting extremely harsh." Rep. Yoon Kun-young said on MBC Radio, "The (convention heat) is more than hot—it's on the verge of explosion," and expressed concern, "The competition is so fierce that I wonder if it can be properly stitched up afterward." Regarding the candidates' mutual mudslinging, he said, "It's as if they're doing politics like there's only today," adding, "It feels like they're pouring everything into winning today, even pulling up the family's very foundations." Rep. Kim Young-jin compared the current competition to the "terminal stage" of the Uri Party, the Democratic Party's predecessor, on SBS Radio. He said, "In 2007, the pro-Roh (pro-Roh Moo-hyun) vs. anti-Roh fight caused many people to leave the party, and in the 2007 presidential election, candidate Chung Dong-young lost by 5 million votes, with the division lasting six to seven years," adding, "We must not go down that path." (중진 의원들 사이에서도 사생결단식 당권 경쟁에 우려하는 목소리가 나왔다. 앞서 “전당대회가 이렇게 가면 (당이) 깨지거나 망한다”고 말한 박지원 의원은 이날 MBC에 출연해 “당대표 후보들이면 서민 경제를 이야기해야지, 박 터지게 싸우면 되겠느냐”며 “발언 수위가 굉장히 거칠어지고 있다”고 했다. 윤건영 의원은 MBC라디오에서 “(전당대회 열기가) 뜨겁다 못해 폭파 직전”이라며 “경쟁이 너무 치열해서 이후에 제대로 봉합이 되겠느냐”고 우려했다. 그는 후보들의 상호 비방전에 대해 “마치 오늘 하루만 하듯 정치를 하는 것 같다”며 “당장 오늘 이기기 위해서 모든 걸 쏟아붓는, 집안 기둥뿌리까지 뽑아놓는 느낌이 든다”고 했다. 김영진 의원은 SBS라디오에서 지금의 경쟁을 민주당 전신인 열린우리당의 ‘말기’와 비교했다. 그는 “2007년 친노(친노무현)·반노 싸움으로 사람들이 많이 탈당했고, 2007년 대선에서 정동영 후보가 500만 표 차로 졌고, 분열의 과정이 6~7년 이어졌다”며 “그런 과정으로 가면 안 된다”고 했다.)

item.title: Internal war over punishment within pro-Han faction over 'roundhouse kick remark' (‘돌려차기 발언’에… 장동혁, 친한계와 징계 내전)
item.description:
Internal war over punishment within pro-Han faction over 'roundhouse kick remark' (‘돌려차기 발언’에… 장동혁, 친한계와 징계 내전)

The leadership of the People Power Party on the 6th effectively requested disciplinary action from the party's ethics committee against pro-Han (pro-Han Dong-hoon) lawmakers Seo Beom-su and Jin Jong-oh, who exchanged inappropriate jokes at an emergency meeting attended by the victim of the 'Busan roundhouse kick case.' The pro-Han faction fired back by raising suspicions that the party's ethics committee chair violated confidentiality obligations by sharing disciplinary-related information with outsiders. The ethics committee is scheduled to hold a meeting on the 7th. (국민의힘 지도부가 6일 ‘부산 돌려차기 사건’ 피해자가 참석한 긴급 간담회에서 부적절한 농담을 주고받은 친한계 서범수·진종오 의원에 대해 당 윤리위원회에 사실상 징계를 요청했다. 친한계는 당 윤리위원장이 징계 관련 정보를 외부 인사와 공유해 비밀유지 의무를 어겼다는 의혹을 제기하며 맞불을 놨다. 윤리위는 7일 회의를 열 예정이다.)

The People Power Party held a supreme council meeting that morning, and chief spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon reported, "Everyone agreed on the seriousness of the (Seo Beom-su and Jin Jong-oh lawmakers') remarks, and opinions were gathered that the ethics committee must take stern measures." The two lawmakers attended a meeting held on the 4th by independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon regarding the prohibition of supplementary investigations by prosecutors. It was a gathering that invited Kim Jin-ju (alias), the victim of the Busan roundhouse kick case, whose truth was revealed through the supplementary investigation. Before Ms. Kim arrived, Rep. Seo said to Rep. Jin, "Should we do a roundhouse kick?" and Rep. Jin, a former national shooting team member, replied, "I use my hands better than my feet." Rep. Seo immediately issued a statement apologizing to Ms. Kim, who accepted the apology and asked the party to focus its efforts on abolishing supplementary investigation powers. Rep. Jin also stated that he visited Ms. Kim in Busan that day to apologize in person. (국민의힘은 이날 오전 최고위원 회의를 열고 “(서범수·진종오 의원) 언행의 심각성에 대해서 모두가 공감했고 관련해서 윤리위의 엄중한 조치가 있어야 된다는 의견이 모였다”고 최보윤 수석대변인이 전했다. 두 의원은 지난 4일 무소속 한동훈 의원이 검찰 보완수사 금지와 관련해 연 간담회에 참석했다. 검찰 보완수사를 통해 진상이 드러난 부산 돌려차기 사건의 피해자 김진주(가명)씨를 초청한 자리였다. 김씨가 도착하기 전 서 의원은 진 의원에게 “돌려차기 한번 하죠?”라고 말했고 사격 국가대표 출신인 진 의원은 “저는 발보다 손을 잘 쓴다”고 했다. 서 의원은 직후 입장문을 내고 김씨에게 사과했고 김씨는 이를 받아들인다며 보완수사권 폐지 문제에 당력을 집중해 달라고 했다. 진 의원도 이날 부산에 있는 김씨를 직접 찾아 사과했다고 밝혔다.)

At the closed supreme council meeting, Supreme Council member Cho Kwang-han reportedly expressed the opinion that they "should take responsibility, including leaving the party." Rep. Jang Dong-hyuk, who said at a press meeting the previous day that "this is not something to end with the word 'inappropriate,'" reportedly did not state a particular position at the supreme council. Pro-Han Supreme Council member Woo Jae-joon said, "I worry that the abolition of supplementary investigation powers will be overshadowed (by the disciplinary controversy)." (비공개 최고위원 회의에서 조광한 최고위원은 “탈당을 비롯한 책임을 져야 한다”는 의견을 낸 것으로 알려졌다. 전날 기자간담회에서 “부적절하다는 수식어로 끝낼 일이 아니다”라고 했던 장동혁 대표는 최고위에선 별다른 입장을 밝히지 않았다고 한다. 친한계인 우재준 최고위원은 “(징계 논란으로) 보완수사권 폐지 부분이 묻힐까 우려된다”고 했다.)

Floor leader Chung Jeom-sik, who did not attend the meeting due to vacation, is known to hold the position that preventing recurrence takes priority over punishment. Floor Leader Chung issued a public apology over the two lawmakers' remarks. He is reportedly concerned that the ethics committee's disciplinary action could escalate into an internal factional conflict. (휴가로 회의에 참석하지 않은 정점식 원내대표는 징계보다 재발 방지가 우선이라는 입장으로 알려졌다. 정 원내대표는 두 의원 발언에 대해 대국민 사과를 했다. 정 원내대표는 윤리위 징계가 당내 계파 갈등으로 번질 것을 우려하는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Officials appointed by Rep. Jang demanded the resignation of the two pro-Han lawmakers, and non-legislative party district chairmen are also demanding disciplinary action. Former lawmaker Shin Ji-ho, former supreme council member Kim Jong-hyuk, and other pro-Han figures outside the legislature raised suspicions that ethics committee chair Yoon Min-woo (professor at Gachon University) leaked disciplinary information to outsiders, demanding an audit of party affairs and the withdrawal of existing punishments, including the expulsion of Rep. Han Dong-hoon. Amid this, the People Power Party's ethics committee is set to hold a meeting on the morning of the 7th to discuss the related matters. The ethics committee is currently experiencing internal strife, with vice chair Woo Jong-hwan (lawyer) demanding the resignation of Chair Yoon Min-woo over the appointment of ethics committee members. (장 대표가 임명한 당직자들은 친한계인 두 의원의 사퇴를 요구했고, 원외 당협위원장도 징계를 요구하고 있다. 신지호 전 의원, 김종혁 전 최고위원 등 친한계 원외 인사들은 윤민우(가천대 교수) 윤리위원장이 외부 인사에게 징계 정보를 유출했다는 의혹을 제기하며 당무 감사와 한동훈 의원 제명 등 기존 징계 철회 등을 요구했다. 이런 가운데 국민의힘 윤리위는 7일 오전 회의를 열고 관련 사안들에 대한 논의를 진행할 예정이다. 윤리위는 현재 윤리위원 임명 등을 놓고 우종환(변호사) 부위원장이 윤민우 위원장의 사퇴를 요구하면서 내홍을 겪고 있다.)

item.title: Lee: "Even a good policy is worse than not doing it if it harms the public" (李 “좋은 정책도 국민에 피해 주면 안하느니만 못해”)
item.description:
Lee: "Even a good policy is worse than not doing it if it harms the public" (李 “좋은 정책도 국민에 피해 주면 안하느니만 못해”)

President Lee Jae-myung said at a meeting of senior secretaries held at the presidential office on the 6th, "Even a policy initiated with good intentions is worse than not doing it if the public cannot feel its effects or, on the contrary, it harms people's lives," adding, "We need an administration that always examines issues from the public's perspective and actively fixes any problems without exception, leaving no area as a sanctuary." President Lee did not mention any specific policy. However, it was interpreted as a remark bearing in mind the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act, which fully abolishes prosecutors' direct investigative powers, a topic circulating in political circles. <<> Regarding President Lee's remarks, Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong also did not disclose which policy was referenced. In a briefing after the meeting, Senior Spokesperson Kang said, "One can refer to the President's remarks from the previous day about preparing measures to ensure the public does not experience confusion or inconvenience during the transition to a new system," and added, "These were not remarks aimed at any specific ministry." <<> The previous day, during the work reports by the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, President Lee asked about the feasibility of operating the existing police-prosecution joint investigation headquarters following the complete abolition of prosecutors' investigative powers, including supplementary investigative authority, under the ruling party's revision of the Criminal Procedure Act. He said, "I haven't read the revised Criminal Procedure Act, so I'm asking this, but does the revised law stipulate that prosecutors must not investigate?" President Lee has previously ordered joint police-prosecution investigations into issues such as the alleged political interference by the religious group Shincheonji and the shortage of ballot papers whenever such matters arose. In legal circles, there were comments that President Lee, a former lawyer, deliberately asked several questions while pretending not to know, in order to point out anticipated side effects such as a decline in investigative capability. <<> At the presidential office meeting that day, a plan to improve the environment for teenagers' use of social networking services (SNS) was also discussed. President Lee reportedly asked detailed questions about cases of age restrictions on overseas SNS use. The Broadcasting and Media Communications Commission had recently reported in its work report that it would pursue measures such as restricting SNS membership for those under 14. President Lee reportedly expressed the view at the meeting that a public discussion process should precede any hasty unilateral regulation. It is also said that within the presidential office, there is an assessment that social media discussions of politics are distorting the political leanings of teenagers. <<> President Lee also said that day, "Young people are now almost becoming a vulnerable group," and "We need to consider reorganizing youth policies around core areas of life such as education, employment, income, assets, housing, and marriage." Recently, the presidential office has made discovering youth policies its top priority based on the judgment that discontent among young people has become serious. Additionally, the presidential office is reviewing the establishment of an organization at the senior secretary level dedicated to large-scale national investments, such as the 'three mega projects.' (이재명 대통령은 6일 청와대에서 열린 수석보좌관 회의에서 “좋은 의도로 시작한 정책이라도 국민이 효과를 체감하지 못하거나, 도리어 국민의 삶에 피해를 준다면 안 하느니만 못한 것”이라며 “항상 국민 눈높이에서 사안을 살피고, 문제가 있으면 어떤 사항도 성역 없이 적극적으로 고치는 행정이 필요하다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 특정 정책을 언급하진 않았다. 다만 정치권에서 검사의 직접 수사권을 전면 폐지한 형사소송법 개정안을 염두에 둔 발언으로 해석됐다.)

item.title: Former Army, Navy, and Air Force Chiefs of Staff: "Opposed to Merging Military Academies" (육·해·공군 前총장들 “사관학교 통합 반대”)
item.description:
Former Army, Navy, and Air Force Chiefs of Staff: "Opposed to Merging Military Academies" (육·해·공군 前총장들 “사관학교 통합 반대”)

Forty-six former chiefs of staff from the Army, Navy, and Air Force issued a statement on the 6th declaring, "We strongly urge the government to reconsider the push to merge the three branches' military academies." This expresses opposition to the government's plan to consolidate the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies into a single "National Defense Academy." (육·해·공군의 역대 참모총장 중 46명이 “3군 사관학교 통합 추진에 대한 재검토를 정부에 강력히 건의한다”는 입장문을 6일 발표했다. 육·해·공군사관학교를 통합해 ‘국군사관학교’를 창설하겠다는 정부 계획에 반대의 뜻을 나타낸 것이다.)

In the statement released that day, the former chiefs of staff said, "Generalizing the political involvement of some soldiers from a particular academy as a problem of the entire institution, and further proposing the merger of the three service academies as a preventive measure, reflects a disconnect between diagnosis and prescription." The previous day, President Lee Jae-myung said during a Ministry of National Defense briefing, "The Korea Military Academy has been at the center of three military coups in this country, yet no one has ever been held accountable. Who's to say it couldn't happen again?" adding, "Merging the academies would reduce that possibility." (이날 공개한 입장문에서 역대 참모총장들은 “특정 사관학교 출신 일부 군인의 정치 개입을 출신 학교 전체의 문제로 일반화하고, 나아가 삼군 사관학교 통합을 그 예방책으로 제시하는 것은 진단과 처방이 어긋나는 것”이라고 했다. 전날 이재명 대통령은 국방부 업무보고에서 “대한민국에서 군사 쿠데타를 무려 세 번이나 한 중심이 육군사관학교인데, 한 번도 책임을 묻지 않았다. 앞으로 또 할 수 있지 않느냐”라며 “(사관학교) 통합을 하면 이럴 가능성이 줄어든다”고 했다.)

The former Army, Navy, and Air Force chiefs of staff stated, "Those who engaged in illegal acts should be held strictly accountable, but discussions on the development of the military academies must proceed based on the fundamental principles of national security and the cultivation of elite officers." They further urged, "Even now, the government should not pursue a physical merger of the academies but instead devise fundamental development plans that elevate the pride and honor of junior officers and attract outstanding talent to the military." (육·해·공군 역대 참모총장들은 “불법행위에 가담한 자에게는 엄정하게 책임을 묻되, 사관학교 발전은 국가 안보와 정예 장교 양성이라는 본질에 따라 논의해야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “정부는 지금이라도 사관학교의 물리적 통합이 아니라 초급 장교들의 자긍심과 명예를 고양하고, 우수한 인재들이 군에 모여들 수 있는 근본적인 발전 방안을 마련해야 한다”고 촉구했다.)

The former chiefs also said, "Each service's military academy has, over a long period, steadily produced officers with the unique identity and expertise of its respective branch," and "Jointness is exercised based on each service's distinct professionalism—it is not achieved simply by educating everyone in the same place." This countered the Ministry of National Defense's longstanding argument that merging the academies is necessary to strengthen "jointness," the seamless cooperation among the Army, Navy, and Air Force to maximize operational effectiveness. (역대 총장들은 “각 군 사관학교는 오랜 기간 각 군 고유의 정체성과 전문성을 갖춘 장교를 안정적으로 양성해 왔다”며 “합동성은 각 군 고유의 전문성을 바탕으로 발휘되는 것이지 동일한 장소에서 함께 교육한다고 발휘되는 것이 아니다”라고도 했다. 국방부는 그동안 육·해·공군이 유기적으로 협력하며 작전 효과를 극대화하는 ‘합동성’ 강화를 위해 사관학교 통합이 필요하다고 주장해 왔는데, 이를 반박한 것이다.)

The statement was signed by a total of 46 individuals, including 18 former Army chiefs of staff, 13 former Navy chiefs of staff, and 15 former Air Force chiefs of staff, regardless of whether they served under conservative or progressive administrations. The chiefs' group said, "This statement is not intended to criticize the government or express a political stance, but to convey to the public and the government the professional views of those who have served as the military's top commanders on a policy with long-term implications for national security." (이번 입장문에는 보수·진보 정부 출신을 가리지 않고 역대 육군참모총장 18명과 해군참모총장 13명, 공군참모총장 15명 등 모두 46명이 이름을 올렸다. 총장단 측은 “입장문은 정부를 비판하거나 정치적 입장을 표명하기 위한 것이 아니라, 국가 안보에 장기적인 영향을 미치는 정책에 대해 군 최고 지휘관을 역임한 사람들의 전문적 견해를 국민과 정부에 전달하기 위한 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: The One Phrase That Moved Eisenhower: "We Need a ROK-U.S. Mutual Defense Treaty" (아이젠하워를 움직인 한마디 “한미상호방위조약이 필요하다”)
item.description:
The One Phrase That Moved Eisenhower: "We Need a ROK-U.S. Mutual Defense Treaty" (아이젠하워를 움직인 한마디 “한미상호방위조약이 필요하다”)

For Paik Sun-yup, there was an undercurrent in the air that was hard to read. In the final stages of negotiations leading up to the armistice of the Korean War in July 1953, the atmosphere felt like a black cloud heavy with moisture was about to unleash a torrential downpour. Negotiations with the communist side were anything but smooth, (백선엽으로서는 짐작하기 어려운 기류가 흘러다니는 중이었다. 1953년 7월 6·25전쟁 휴전 조인을 앞둔 막바지 협상 국면에서는 물기를 잔뜩 품은 시커먼 구름이 커다란 비를 퍼붓고야 말 분위기였다. 공산 측과의 협상은 전혀 순조롭지 않았고,)

and the coordination between Korea and the United States ahead of the armistice signing was far from uncomplicated either. President Syngman Rhee openly and without a moment's hesitation voiced the possibility of "advancing north alone," while the United States, struggling to finalize the armistice arrangements, was on edge over the possibility of the entire framework collapsing. (휴전 조인을 앞둔 한국과 미국의 의사 조율도 결코 순탄치 않은 상황이었다. 이승만 대통령은 한치의 망설임도 없이 ‘단독 북진’에 관한 가능성을 공공연히 외쳤고, 휴전 막바지 조율에 애를 먹던 미국은 전체 판이 깨질지도 모를 상황에 신경을 곤두세우고 있었다.)

In the midst of all this, Paik Sun-yup's sudden schedule to visit the United States unfolded, and an unplanned meeting with U.S. President Eisenhower was also abruptly arranged. Paik Sun-yup, guided by the Secret Service, entered the Oval Office to meet with President Eisenhower. (그 와중에 백선엽의 느닷없는 방미 일정이 이어졌고, 예정에도 없던 미 대통령 아이젠하워와의 면담이 또한 갑자기 이뤄진 터였다. 백선엽은 백악관 경호팀의 안내에 따라 아이젠하워 대통령과 면담할 오벌룸으로 들어섰다.)

The U.S. military intelligence officer Lieutenant Colonel Howze, who accompanied him, and the male captain who served as interpreter, were held back by the security team and had to wait within the White House grounds. President Eisenhower reportedly greeted Army Chief of Staff Paik, who had briefed him on the plan to strengthen Korean forces during Eisenhower's visit to Korea as president-elect, with great warmth. Their conversation reportedly began with Eisenhower asking, "How is President Rhee doing?" (수행했던 미군 정보당국자인 하우즈만 중령과 통역으로 따라나섰던 남성인 대위는 경호팀의 제지에 따라 함께 동행하지 못한 채 백악관 구내에서 기다려야 했다. 아이젠하워 대통령은 당선자 시절 방한했을 때 한국군 전력 증강계획을 브리핑했던 백선엽 총장을 매우 반갑게 맞아줬다고 한다. 둘의 대화는 아이젠하워가 “이승만 대통령 잘 계시느냐”는 인사로 시작했다고 한다.)

The content of the conversation between Paik and Eisenhower during his visit to the White House is not recorded anywhere. The only detailed account comes from Paik's own memoirs. Given the urgent circumstances with the armistice looming, the tensions and contradictions brewing between the Korean and U.S. administrations during that process, and the fact that the meeting between Paik and the U.S. president took place under tight security on an unscheduled basis, their conversation carries enormous significance. (백선엽이 백악관을 방문해 아이젠하워와 나눈 대화 내용은 어디에도 실려 있지 않다. 그나마 자세한 내용을 전하는 것은 백선엽의 회고뿐이다. 휴전을 코앞에 둔 긴박한 상황, 그 과정에서 번지고 있던 한국과 미국 행정부 사이의 갈등과 모순, 예정에도 없던 일정으로 보안 속에 이뤄진 백선엽과 미국 대통령의 대화 등의 조건 때문에 둘의 대화는 의미가 매우 크다.)

After serializing Paik's memoirs through the JoongAng Ilbo, where I was employed, I continued to meet with him for about ten years until his passing, conducting necessary interviews along the way. The "Paik-Eisenhower" dialogue, which the memoir in the JoongAng Ilbo did not fully cover, was something I was able to hear more about during that time. (필자는 재직하던 중앙일보를 통해 백선엽의 회고록을 연재한 뒤 그가 타계하기 전까지 약 10년 동안 줄곧 만남을 이어갔고, 필요한 취재를 진행했다. 중앙일보 회고록에서 못다 적은 ‘백선엽-아이젠하워’ 대화는 그 과정에서 조금 더 들을 수 있었다.)

Eisenhower's opening greeting reportedly carried its own weight. For Eisenhower, it may have been an attempt to gauge something from Paik. To the question "How is the President doing?" Paik responded politely, conveying regards from President Rhee. In reality, Paik had never received any message from President Rhee to pass on to Eisenhower. It was merely a courteous gesture he made up on the spot. But what came next was crucial. (아이젠하워의 첫인사는 나름 의미가 있었다고 한다. 아이젠하워로서는 백선엽에게서 무언가를 읽어보려는 인사말이었을 수도 있었기 때문이다. “대통령 잘 계시냐”는 물음에 백선엽은 공손하게 이승만 대통령 인사를 전하는 내용으로 대꾸했다. 실제 이승만 대통령에게 아이젠하워 대통령에게 전하라는 인사를 백선엽은 받은 적이 없다. 그냥 의례껏 만들어 전한 인사에 불과했다. 그러나 다음 대목이 중요했다.)

Eisenhower said, "We are well aware that President Rhee and the Korean people oppose the armistice. However, the armistice of the Korean War is something I pledged as a campaign promise. The allied nations who fought alongside us are also urging an armistice." Paik's response to that was unequivocal. He reportedly told Eisenhower, "I am well aware of those circumstances. But if an armistice is reached under these conditions, the unification of Korea will become extremely difficult. The United States must truly understand the feelings of the Korean people, who desperately long for unification." (아이젠하워는 “우리는 이승만 대통령과 한국 국민들이 휴전을 반대하고 있다는 사실을 잘 알고 있다. 그러나 한국전쟁의 휴전은 내가 선거 공약으로 내걸었던 사안이다. 함께 참전했던 우방국들 또한 휴전을 권장하고 있다”고 했다. 그에 대한 백선엽의 대답은 분명했다. 그는 아이젠하워에게 “그런 사정은 잘 알고 있다. 그러나 이 상태에서 휴전이 이뤄진다면 한국의 통일은 매우 어려워진다. 통일을 간절히 바라는 한국인들의 심정을 미국은 잘 헤아려야 한다”고 답했다고 한다.)

He then reportedly added, "It is not just President Rhee—all Koreans fervently desire unification. Unification is what every one of our people wishes for." Eisenhower reportedly watched Paik very closely as he said this. (그는 이어 “이승만 대통령뿐 아니라 한국인들 또한 모두 통일을 열망하고 있다. 통일은 우리 국민 모두가 바라는 것이다”라고 덧붙였다고 한다. 그런 백선엽을 아이젠하워는 매우 주의 깊게 바라보고 있었다고 한다.)

At that point, Eisenhower reportedly asked, "Then, what should we do?" This was the very question Paik had been mulling over all night. It was also the theme that Admiral Arleigh Burke, the U.S. Chief of Naval Operations, had raised when he visited him during the night. Paik reportedly began his answer to Eisenhower's question with these words: "Before the armistice, the United States must guarantee one thing to Korea." (이 대목에서 아이젠하워는 “그럼, 우리가 뭘 어떻게 해야 하느냐”고 물었다고 한다. 밤새 백선엽이 생각을 가다듬었던 대목이었다. 아울러 밤중에 찾아온 알레이 버크 미 해군성 작전국장이 건네준 화두(話頭)이기도 했다. 백선엽은 아이젠하워의 그 반문에 먼저 이렇게 대답했다고 한다. “휴전에 앞서 미국이 한국에 하나를 보장해줘야 한다.”)

In his memoirs during his lifetime, Paik recalled, "The first word that came to mind during my meeting with President Eisenhower was 'ruins.' I may not have conveyed it in precise English, but I remember expressing it as 'a land where nothing remains.' As I said that, I calmly explained in English that leaving large numbers of communist forces in the northern part of the Korean Peninsula while concluding an armistice would be extremely dangerous." (백선엽은 생전 회고에서 “아이젠하워 대통령과의 면담에서 우선 떠올린 말이 ‘폐허(廢墟)’였다. 정확한 영어로 전달하지는 못했겠지만, ‘아무것도 남아 있지 않은 땅’이라는 표현을 했던 것으로 기억한다. 그 말을 하면서 한반도 북쪽에 아직 많은 공산군을 그대로 두고 휴전을 한다는 것은 매우 위험하다는 말을 영어로 차분하게 설명했다”고 했다.)

After hearing Paik's remarks, President Eisenhower reportedly asked, "Then, what is this guarantee you're talking about?" At that moment, Paik brought out the word he had heard drummed into his ears by Arleigh Burke during the night and had mulled over countless times himself. He reportedly said to Eisenhower with a grave expression, "We need a mutual defense treaty." (그런 백선엽의 언급을 들은 뒤 아이젠하워 대통령은 “그렇다면, 당신이 말하는 보장이라는 게 뭐냐”고 물었다고 한다. 그 대목에서 밤중에 찾아온 알레이버크로부터 귀에 못이 박히도록 들었고, 본인도 골백번을 생각했을 단어를 꺼냈다는 것이다. 그는 정색을 하며 아이젠하워에게 “상호방위조약이 필요하다”고 말했다고 한다.)

Paik remembered that Eisenhower then smiled with a very awkward look on his face. Eisenhower reportedly went on to say, "Mutual defense treaties exist in cases with European nations, but with Asian countries, it is a very, very rare case." Of the words Eisenhower used at the time, Paik remembered the key phrases and expressions with striking clarity. (그러자 아이젠하워는 매우 어색한 표정을 지으며 웃었다고 백선엽은 기억했다. 아이젠하워는 이어 “상호 방위 조약은 미국이 유럽 국가들과 맺은 사례는 있지만, 아시아 국가와는 매우, 매우 드문 사례(very, very rare case)”라고 말했다고 한다. 당시 아이젠하워가 언급한 말 중 백선엽은 핵심 단어와 표현을 매우 또렷하게 기억했다.)

However, Paik could not clearly recall how long the meeting with Eisenhower lasted or what other topics were discussed. It was likely because all his attention was focused solely on the ultimate goal of the meeting: the "mutual defense treaty." Another part Paik remembered vividly was Eisenhower's remark about the "mutual defense treaty." (그러나 백선엽은 아이젠하워와의 면담이 얼마나 이어졌는지, 그 외에 다른 언급은 무엇이었는지 잘 기억하지 못했다. 오로지 이루고자 했던 면담의 최종 목표, ‘상호 방위 조약’에 그의 온 신경이 집중하고 있었던 까닭이었을 것이다. 백선엽이 강렬하게 기억하고 있던 다른 대목은 ‘상호 방위 조약’에 대한 아이젠하워의 언급이었다.)

It was the statement, "I agree with that in principle." Eisenhower also reportedly noted, "This is a matter that requires the consent of the Senate." This echoed what he had said in December 1952 when, as president-elect, he had visited Korea and listened to Paik's briefing on the plan to strengthen Korean forces. (“나도 원칙적으로(in principle) 그에 동의한다”라는 말이었다. 아울러 아이젠하워는 “상원의 동의를 거쳐야 하는 사안”이라는 점을 말했다고 한다. 1952년 12월 대통령 당선자 신분으로 방한했을 당시 백선엽의 한국군 증강 계획에 관한 브리핑을 듣고 했던 언급과 같았다.)

Regarding the "mutual defense treaty," there may have already been some rapport between the U.S. administration and the Korean government. The United States may have been considering it favorably, or it may have been a hint that such a possibility lay ahead. But the fact that the phrase "mutual defense treaty" came from the U.S. president's mouth was extremely significant. (‘상호 방위 조약’에 관해서는 미국 행정부와 한국 정부 사이에 이미 교감이 있었을지 모를 사안이었다. 미국이 전향적으로 검토 중이었을 수도 있었고, 향후 그럴지도 모른다는 점을 암시한 대목이었을 수도 있었다. 그러나 미 대통령의 입에서 ‘상호 방위 조약’이라는 단어가 나왔다는 점은 매우 중요했다.)

Eisenhower reportedly asked Paik, "How much longer will you stay in the United States?" He even went so far as to say, "Go to the State Department tomorrow morning and meet with Under Secretary Walter Smith to discuss the details." Paik reportedly told Eisenhower that, beyond the mutual defense treaty, Korea—being little more than ruins—was in desperate need of economic aid. Eisenhower's mention of the "State Department meeting" was a gesture of consideration for that request. The next day, Paik reportedly headed straight back to the U.S. State Department. (아이젠하워는 백선엽에게 “앞으로 미국에 얼마 더 체류하느냐”고 물었다. 이어 “내일 아침 국무부로 가서 월터 스미스 차관보와 면담하면서 자세한 이야기를 나누라”고까지 했다. 백선엽은 상호 방위 조약에 관한 언급 뒤 ‘폐허’나 다름없는 한국에는 경제 지원이 절실하다는 내용을 아이젠하워에게 말했다고 한다. 아이젠하워가 언급한 ‘국무부 면담’은 백선엽의 그 요청에 대한 배려였다. 이튿날 백선엽은 다시 미 국무부로 곧장 향했다고 한다.)

item.title: 46 Former Army, Navy, and Air Force Chiefs of Staff Strongly Recommend Reconsidering Military Academy Integration (前 육·해·공군총장 46명 “사관학교 통합 재검토 강력 건의”)
item.description:
46 Former Army, Navy, and Air Force Chiefs of Staff Strongly Recommend Reconsidering Military Academy Integration (前 육·해·공군총장 46명 “사관학교 통합 재검토 강력 건의”)

Forty-six former Chiefs of Staff of the Army, Navy, and Air Force opposed the establishment of the "National Defense Academy," which merges the three service academies, and urged a policy reconsideration on the 6th. (육·해·공군의 역대 참모총장 46명이 6일 육·해·공군 3군 사관학교를 통폐합한 ‘국군사관학교’ 창설에 반대하며 정책 재검토를 촉구했다.)

In a statement released on the 6th, the former Chiefs of Staff group said, "Generalizing the political involvement of some soldiers from a particular academy to the entire alumni body, and further proposing the integration of the three service academies as a preventive measure, is a mismatch between diagnosis and prescription," adding, "Those who participated in illegal acts should be held strictly accountable, but the development of the academies should be discussed based on the essence of national security and the cultivation of elite officers." They further urged, "What matters more than the physical integration of the academies is what kind of officers the Republic of Korea will produce," and called for "fundamental development plans that allow outstanding talent to choose the military while simultaneously advancing each service's expertise and jointness." <<> The statement was signed by a total of 46 individuals: 18 former Army Chiefs of Staff, 13 former Navy Chiefs of Staff, and 15 former Air Force Chiefs of Staff. Among them, 26—including 9 from the Army, 6 from the Navy, and 11 from the Air Force—attended a meeting held the previous day at the Air Force Hotel in Seoul. The Chiefs of Staff group stated, "The statement is not intended to criticize the government or express a political stance, but to convey to the public and the government the professional views of those who have served as the military's top commanders on a policy that has long-term implications for national security." <<> The former Chiefs of Staff argued that the government has failed to concretely demonstrate the necessity of academy integration. They said, "Each service academy has steadily produced officers with the unique identity and expertise of its respective service over a long period," and "Jointness is exercised based on each service's unique expertise, not by simply educating them together in the same place." This refutes the Ministry of National Defense's push for integrating the three service academies under the rationale of "strengthening jointness." However, President Lee Jae-myung said on the 5th, "All military coups in the Republic of Korea were instigated by the Army, by graduates of the Korea Military Academy," and "Integration would reduce the likelihood of this." This suggests that academy integration is needed more for "preventing coups" than for strengthening jointness, a stance somewhat different in tone from the arguments previously made by Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek and the Ministry. <<> The government and the Democratic Party of Korea announced a basic plan last month to establish the National Defense Academy by integrating the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies at Jaun-dae, Daejeon. The Ministry of National Defense has argued that integration is essential to address the decline in the school-age population, eliminate redundancy in facilities and faculty, strengthen jointness, and prepare for future warfare. However, unlike President Lee, the Ministry has never cited "coup prevention" as a reason for integration thus far. (역대 참모총장단은 6일 입장문을 내고 “특정 사관학교 출신 일부 군인들의 정치개입을 출신학교 전체의 문제로 일반화하고, 나아가 삼군 사관학교 통합을 그 예방책으로 제시하는 것은 진단과 처방이 어긋나는 것”이라며 “불법행위에 가담한 자에게는 엄정하게 책임을 묻되, 사관학교 발전은 국가안보와 정예장교 양성이라는 본질에 따라 논의해야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “사관학교의 물리적 통합 여부보다 중요한 것은 대한민국이 어떤 장교를 길러낼 것인가”라며 “각 군의 전문성과 합동성을 함께 발전시키면서 우수한 인재가 군을 선택할 수 있는 근본적인 발전방안을 마련해 달라”고 촉구했다.)

The following are the former Chiefs of Staff who signed the statement. (이번 입장문에는 역대 육군참모총장 18명과 해군참모총장 13명, 공군참모총장 15명 등 모두 46명이 이름을 올렸다. 이들 가운데 육군 9명과 해군 6명, 공군 11명 등 26명은 전날 서울 공군호텔에서 열린 간담회에 직접 참석했다. 총장단 측은 “입장문은 정부를 비판하거나 정치적 입장을 표명하기 위한 것이 아니라, 국가안보에 장기적인 영향을 미치는 정책에 대해 군 최고 지휘관을 역임한 사람들의 전문적 견해를 국민과 정부에 전달하기 위한 것”이라고 했다.)
